name: Project: Celestia
source:
5 years have passed since the Alliance War of Independence, also know as the First Space War...

Awoken from his confines, Elais finds himself in a seemingly abandoned space station. While roaming its empty hallways, he's greeted by a familiar humming, which guides him to a dimly lit hangar, where he encounters a giant mech, in front of which stands a mysterious girl, welcoming him. This is where the story begins.

[Edited from the [url=https://63b2aa41e1bc6.site123.me/games/project-celestia-prologue]official website[/url]]
translation:
联盟独立战争，又称第一次宇宙战争，结束至今已过去5年……

Elais从囚禁中醒来，发现自己身处一座看似废弃的空间站。他游荡在空无一人的走廊里，听到熟悉的哼唱声，循声来到灯光昏暗的机库。一台巨大的机甲出现在眼前，机甲前站着一位神秘少女，迎接他的到来。故事由此开始。

[编译自[url=https://63b2aa41e1bc6.site123.me/games/project-celestia-prologue]official website[/url]]
